scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Winning Looks Natural on You
cards.instruction: Treat the ease and confidence success seems to give others as both inspiring and threatening, then sharpen your need to outperform them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so casual collecting that prize. I'll collect mine without even standing fully up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm preparing a more effortless response.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're practising it in a mirror.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only until it looks less prepared than yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sold every painting without looking busy. Book me the bigger room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Start with six. I'll help you hang them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve. Show me that relaxed lean you did beside the prices.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could relax because you handled all my sales.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll sell my own twelve, glass in hand. You just keep me topped up.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies B's casual success competitively, and A5 explicitly wants the rehearsed response to look less prepared than B's.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 reframes B2's lack of a prize as preparation time; A5 uses B4's mirror practice as work toward superior ease.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 credibly puncture A's claim, although B has little expressed want beyond correcting the performance.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns evidence of strenuous rehearsal into a reason to keep pursuing an even more effortless appearance.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies prize collection and a physical reception tactic; B4 locates A's rehearsal at a mirror.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'more effortless response' culminates economically in A5's competitive standard of looking unprepared.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 links B's effortless sellout to wanting the bigger room; A3 copies B's relaxed lean while doubling B2's suggested six paintings. Inspiration and competitive threat both inform A's ambition, although the threat remains implicit.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 proposes six paintings and hanging help; A3 counters with twelve and requests help imitating B's ease. B4 reveals that A handled B's sales, causing A5 to undertake both selling and appearing relaxed.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers practical support and a manageable exhibition size. B4 credits A's work while correcting A's impression of effortless success, changing what A5 must attempt to surpass B.

heightening.evidence: After B4 exposes the labor behind B's relaxed appearance, A5 commits to selling all twelve personally while holding a glass, assigning B only the supporting task of replenishing it.

specificity.evidence: A1 immediately establishes a sold-out painting exhibition and a request for a larger room. A3's lean beside the prices and A5's glass give actors concrete, playable expressions of competitive ease.

brevityWit.evidence: B4's concise revelation reframes A1's envy. A5's 'You just keep me topped up' earns its humor by reducing B to refreshment support while A claims the harder version of B's success.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2's 'Start with six' supplies the number A3 competitively doubles to twelve; the offer of practical help becomes a request to learn B's relaxed pose.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 explains that B could relax because A handled sales. A5 therefore proposes handling personal sales while displaying leisure, attempting to exceed the newly revealed standard.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 envies success that looks unhurried; A3 imitates its visible confidence while increasing the exhibition's scale; A5 insists on achieving that appearance under greater workload.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 combines A3's twelve paintings with B4's sales workload and adds a glass-in-hand performance of ease. The request to B remains fictional dialogue and leaves the exhibition unresolved.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: S205 makes another person's apparent ease both a model and a threat, driving A to outperform that very ease.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Vanity seeks an attractive appearance without necessarily borrowing a successful rival's confidence as its competitive target.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 names B's casual prize collection as the model, while A5's 'less prepared than yours' makes superiority over B the explicit goal.

records.recommendedEdit: Corrected only the rejected gallery candidate's A5; the original firstPass remains exact. The illustrative gallery setting remains, with a reception drink replacing the inferred simultaneous exhibitions. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, because A1 targets B's effortless sellout, A3 copies the lean while doubling B2's suggested paintings, and A5 undertakes the sales work B needed A to perform while retaining a leisurely pose; logic 5, because B2's six prompts A3's twelve and B4's disclosure prompts A5 to handle those twelve sales personally; relationship 4, because B2 offers practical help and B4 credits A's labor, which A5 converts into a smaller hospitality role for B; heightening 4, because A5 adds selling to exhibiting and insists on doing it glass in hand; specificity 4, because A1 establishes room booking and A3 locates the imitated confidence beside prices, though B's booking authority remains implicit; brevity 4, because A5's top-up request embodies the desired ease without explaining its impression. Weighted total 90. Internal reread confirms five spoken ABABA turns, 63 words, causal partner contributions and an open proposal. Compared with the frozen running alternative's competitive recovery assistance, this scene converts an artistic colleague's acknowledgment of hidden labor into a bid to surpass that colleague's self-sufficiency and composure.
records.remainingConcern: A1 and A3 imply insecurity through immediate competitive escalation rather than making it especially palpable. B's original painting count is unspecified, so twelve establishes ambition without proving numerical superiority. No rewrite is needed for this internal pass.
records.writerReservation: A5 proposes effortless selling rather than demonstrating a completed sale, leaving the outcome open. Champagne is no longer specified; the reception glass remains an illustrative addition. B still supplies hospitality, so A's claim to superiority rests on handling the sales personally, not on eliminating all help.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved S205-single-b uses a fellow runner's exhaustion and offer of companionship to prompt competitive helpfulness. This gallery alternative uses practical exhibition support and a revelation about hidden labor to prompt imitation and a reversal of supporting roles. The distinction is meaningful; the reference alternative is not scored.
